notes.title: Beta Testing Begins
notes.content: [p]Attention, Class D personnel:[/p][p]The SCP Foundation is pleased to inform you that beta testing for [b]SCP Containment Breach on Steam[/b] has commenced. The initial batch of testing keys has been distributed to authorized participants. The current version is based on build 1.3.11 and includes support for the Steam overlay, as well as Steam Cloud support for your saved games and custom music tracks.[/p][p]If you wish to be considered for future testing opportunities and receive upcoming beta keys, you may enter your email address in our newsletter system, through the designated link below.[/p][p][url="https://www.leadwerks.com/scpcb"]Join the Beta[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Please, stay alert and follow all protocol guidelines. The Foundation thanks you in advance for your compliance.[/p]

notes.title: Steam Store Page Restored
notes.content: [p]We are pleased to announce that the SCP Containment Breach Steam store page has been restored. The page was temporarily delisted on July 18 due to the filing of a fraudulent DMCA takedown notice. We have worked diligently with Valve to resolve the issue, and the store page is now active again. Fans and new players can once more add SCP Containment Breach to their wishlists and access all related content.[/p][p]Our team remains committed to enhancing the SCP Containment Breach experience, while preserving the integrity of the original game, as it was intended to be played. We are actively working on Steam features like achievements and cloud saves, and developing an improved version of the original level design tools used in creating the game.[/p][p]We sincerely appreciate your patience and continued support during this time. Thank you for standing with us as we work to bring you the best possible experience. We also want to thank Undertow Games for their support and for granting us permission to publish SCP Containment Breach on Steam—without their trust and cooperation, this would not have been possible.[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=XMPRJMQJBuM"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: SCP Containment Breach on Steam
notes.content: [p]I'm pleased to announce that in cooperation with [url="https://www.undertowgames.com"]Undertow Games[/url], we are preparing to release the original indie survival horror game [b]SCP Containment Breach[/b] [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3831680/SCP_Containment_Breach/"]on Steam[/url]. The game was built on some of the technology I cut my teeth on, the late [url="https://github.com/blitz-research/blitz3d"]Mark Sibly's Blitz3D[/url] programming language and engine. My own editor [b]3D World Studio[/b] was used in the production of the game, although I was not involved in the process. The developer has graciously allowed us to curate the game on Steam, bringing this terrifying and unique indie experience to a new audience. I am also investigating how we can update 3D World Studio to run on modern Windows and include it as a modding tool for the game.[/p][p]Please [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3831680/SCP_Containment_Breach"]add this free game to your wishlist[/url] on Steam now.[/p]
